_: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for credential shapes (rsc-889, rsc-xam).
Two engines consume this file: the Python pre-commit guard (credentials.py,
which DETECTS and refuses a commit) and the TypeScript evidence mask
(runtime/credential-mask.ts, which REDACTS before a payload reaches Postgres
and the next agent's prompt). Same shapes, different verbs.
It is data, not code, for one reason: two hand-maintained copies in two
languages WILL drift, and the drift is silent — the guard keeps passing while
the mask quietly stops covering a category, or the reverse. The TS side is
GENERATED from this file (gen-ts-patterns.py) and a test regenerates and
byte-compares, exactly like the prose drift gate does for quest YAML.
DIALECT RULE: every regex here must mean the same thing to Python `re` and to
JavaScript RegExp. That is why there are no named groups (Python spells them
(?P<x>...), JS spells them (?<x>...)) — `valued` patterns use plain group 1 —
and no inline flags: flags are declared in the `flags` field ('i' only).
A cross-engine conformance test proves the agreement rather than trusting it.
Every pattern is a VENDOR-DEFINED format: a fixed prefix plus a known length.
No entropy heuristics, no model. Minimums sit below the real length (a real
Anthropic key runs ~100 chars after the prefix) but far above anything prose
produces: the prefix does the work, the length only rules out 'sk-ant-REDACTED'.

simple.note: sk-ant-api03-<~95>. The OpenAI lookahead below keeps these two off the same span.
AKIA long-lived / ASIA STS session + exactly 16 uppercase-alnum.
PEM header; [A-Z]+ covers RSA / EC / OPENSSH / DSA / (none).

jwt.note: Three base64url segments; eyJ is base64 of '{"'. Skipped inside a URL — see the url_scheme rule.

valued.note: ~/.claude/.credentials.json shape. Anchors on the KEY because the token itself has no prefix.
The loosest shape here: 'Bearer' is an ordinary word, so it leans on the placeholder rule.

placeholder.note: Checked against the captured VALUE only, never the surrounding text, so a real token containing 'example' is not excused by it.
